remarks:
Welcome to a truly special Ellicottville home, rich with character, charm, and room to enjoy every season. Set in the heart of this beloved ski village—often called the “Aspen of the East”—you’re just a stroll from the shops, restaurants, and local favorites that make Ellicottville so memorable.The side deck leads into a practical ski-room entry and a spacious eat-in kitchen, with an enclosed porch just beyond. The main level also features a bedroom and two full baths, plus plenty of room to gather: a large dining room, a welcoming family room, and a front living room anchored by a beautiful stone fireplace. Upstairs, you’ll find five generously sized bedrooms and another full bath. Warm wood floors, charming wood ceilings, and abundant windows give the home a cozy, inviting feel—with plenty of space for hosting family and friends. HoliMont’s Cascade chairlift is just a short walk away.And there’s more: a large historic barn building sits behind the home, backing up to Plum Creek. With a full upper level and loads of potential, it could become a distinctive guest cottage or a seasonal rental opportunity. Ample parking adds even more convenience.
Full of possibilities and village charm, this is a property ready to welcome its next chapter.
